title: Current String Template baseline
summary: String Template 0.1-dev3 is the current repository candidate. It preserves the dev2 interpolation language and requirement inspection while making formatter bindings deterministic through sealed registry snapshots and explicit rebinding.
invariants: Template source is data and is never passed to INTERPRET.
The package is runtime authority; this sphere is continuity/documentation authority.
Native ooRexx values remain objects until a formatter produces textual output.
Compiled requirement inspection remains available before domain formatter bindings are supplied.
No runtime PASS is inferred from structural or standards checks.
